name: nonApi_replaceBrokenPhoto
description: Replaces a profile photo whose blob no longer exists with a bundled avatar (E16.F3.S1). Called only by the ReportBrokenPhoto Azure Function, and only after that function has HEAD-checked the URL against blob storage and been told it is gone — a phone's report is never acted on unverified. Corrects HC.Hasher.Photo (replaced) and HC.HasherKennelMap.KennelUserPhoto (cleared; the app falls back to the hasher photo). Both tables re-sync the corrected rows through their updatedAt triggers.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The photo URL the phone could not load and storage has confirmed missing. Matched exactly against Hasher.Photo (NVARCHAR(1000)) and HasherKennelMap.KennelUserPhoto (NVARCHAR(500)).

parameters.name: replacement
parameters.description: The bundled-avatar URL written in place of the missing photo (https://harriercentral.blob.core.windows.net/profile-photos/avatar-N.jpg).

parameters.name: httpStatus
parameters.description: The status blob storage answered the HEAD with (404 or 410). Recorded in the LOG.GeneralLog line only.

rowsets.name: ReplacedCounts
rowsets.description: One row: how many rows each table corrected. Zero in both means the URL was already gone from the database (a second phone reporting the same photo).

columns.name: HasherRows
columns.description: HC.Hasher rows whose Photo was replaced.

columns.name: KennelRows
columns.description: HC.HasherKennelMap rows whose KennelUserPhoto was cleared.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Hasher SET Photo = @replacement WHERE Photo = @url AND deleted = 0 — fires trgUpdateModifiedOnDateForHasher so every client re-syncs the hasher on its next delta.
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap SET KennelUserPhoto = NULL WHERE KennelUserPhoto = @url — fires the HKM updatedAt trigger.
Inserts one LOG.GeneralLog row (LogSource 'ReportBrokenPhoto') recording the URL, the status and the row counts.
On any runtime error: rolls back, logs to HC.ErrorLog, re-throws.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
